clips.order: the first track, then tracks spread evenly through the album (bit-reversal order), so fewer clips are a prefix of more

pooling: the plain mean (float64, not renormalised) of the album's first 4 ok clips in rank order, from one listing; windows of full-length audio (local, youtube, bandcamp) replace the previews and the mean then takes every window; stored as float16

shards.note: album means of the one-pass clip cache, 4 clips per album (rmr_audio.modelstore write)
